# aidial_alias (Resource)

Manages an alias in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/aliases/{bucket}/{path}`): an alternative invocation name that points at a model, application or toolset and can override how it is presented and who may use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An alias that is invoked as "fast-chat" and points at an application.
resource "aidial_alias" "example" {
  bucket      = "public"
  path        = "fast-chat"
  present_as  = "model"
  target_path = "applications/my-application"

  display_name         = "Fast chat"
  description          = "Short name for the chat application"
  user_roles           = ["admin"]
  description_keywords = ["chat", "fast"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Must be "public" or "platform".
- `path` (String) Alias path inside the bucket, which is also the name the alias is invoked by. DIAL Core accepts letters, digits and `._%:@[]()-`, so it cannot contain `/`.
- `present_as` (String) What the alias is shown as: `model`, `application` or `toolset`. An alias shown as a toolset must point at a toolset; one shown as a model or application cannot point at a toolset.
- `target_path` (String) The deployment the alias points at: `models/<name>`, `applications/<name>` or `toolsets/<name>`. DIAL Core does not check that the target exists.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Alias description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String) Keywords that help find the alias by description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable alias name.
- `display_version` (String) Version shown for the alias.
- `icon_url` (String) URL of the alias icon.
- `intro` (String) Introductory text shown for the alias.
- `name` (String) Alias name sent in the DIAL API request body. It must equal the last segment of `path`, so it can be omitted; then it is read back from the API.
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the alias.

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) Canonical alias name returned by the DIAL API.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = aidial_alias.example
  id = "public/fast-chat"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>. DIAL Core accepts the "public" and "platform" buckets for aliases.
terraform import aidial_alias.example public/fast-chat
```
